description: Asks a second model to review your plans, stuck attempts and finished work, with cited findings, and can flag output you should know about

every_turn.title: Review every turn
every_turn.description: Ask the advisor after every finished turn, not only on triggers or /advisor

route.title: Advisor model
route.description: The model route the advisor runs on; it needs its own model access

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: advisory: the lead model weighs the advice. blocking: also needs a workflow contract with an advisor review gate

triggers.title: Automatic triggers
triggers.description: When to ask without /advisor: failure (same call failed twice), loop (same output three times), completion (turns that changed files)

share.title: What it sees
share.description: What the advisor may read: conversation, diff and files

observe.title: Flag things to know
observe.description: Watch the lead's output and flag behavior changes, unresolved failures and decisions you need to make

skip_same_model.title: Skip same model
skip_same_model.description: Don't ask when the advisor would run on the same model as the lead
